decision_reason: Genesearch is a named JGI/KBase gene-homology search service with publicly inspectable Go source, a BSD-3-Clause-LBNL grant, detailed build/configuration/API user documentation, and first-party evidence that the service is currently available through JGI IMG/M. The KBase co-development page links the exact public GitLab source, connecting the public code to the operating service; that current product evidence supports the older source cadence. The README supplies installation, configuration, REST/OpenAPI, and runtime guidance.

decision_reason: GENESPACE is an identified JGI Plant Program tool with a public current distribution, an inspected BSD-3-Clause grant plus LBNL enhancement permission, substantive installation and user tutorials, and a peer-reviewed tool paper documenting scientific use. The DOE CODE lead is an earlier JGI GitLab copy; its README and the JGI current-version link establish GitHub as the current distribution, and the LICENSE-add commit SHA is shared across GitHub and the GitLab history. This is one GENESPACE product, not a second product for the DOE-hosted copy.

Direct report: https://archive.jgi.doe.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/03/Beyond-Basepairs-Implementation-Report-2024.pdf. The official JGI Plant Program page also names GENESPACE as a resource, describes its functions, and links its latest version to the current source repository; the page identifies LBNL as a U.S. DOE Office of Science lab. This supports JGI/DOE development, integration, and stewardship, not government copyright ownership: the source LICENSE copyright holder is HudsonAlpha Institute for Biotechnology.

decision_reason: BiG-SLiCE is a mature, versioned scientific software family. The maintained upstream provides installation, quick-start, and user documentation, has a v2.0.2 release, and was used in a 2026 peer-reviewed BiG-SLiCE 2.0 paper. Treat BiG-SLiCE 2 as the major version of the existing BiG-SLiCE product family, not as a separate catalog product. This workspace had no existing BiG-SLiCE catalog entry at review time.
